title: Pure Infernoid
summary: Pure Infernoid banish-summoning and board-wipe control build, unleashing the demonic mechanical legion through Void Spells and Traps. The archetype Special Summons itself from hand or graveyard by banishing fellow Infernoids while your total monster Levels are 8 or lower, tribute-negating disruptions and resolving massive mills through Infernoid Evil and Void Feast.

summary.title: Starters & Void Engine
points: Infernoid Decatron (Level 1 Tuner) sends an Infernoid monster from your Deck to the GY upon Normal or Special Summon, gaining that monster's Level, name, and activated effects.
Void Vanishment discards 1 card to search any Void Spell or Trap Card (such as Void Feast or Void Imagination) from your Deck.

Void Feast sends 1 face-up Void Spell/Trap you control to the GY to Special Summon up to 3 Infernoid monsters from your Deck whose total Levels equal exactly 8 (typically two Decatrons and one Level 6 Infernoid Sjette).

Void Imagination treats all Infernoid monsters you control as Level 1, and sends itself to the GY to perform a Fusion Summon using up to 6 materials from your Deck if your opponent controls an Extra Deck monster.

summary.title: Opening: Void Feast
steps: Set Void Feast and activate Void Vanishment (or Void Expansion) face-up on the field.
During the opponent's Draw Phase or Main Phase, activate Void Feast by sending the face-up Void Spell to the GY.
Special Summon two copies of Infernoid Decatron (Level 1 each) and one Infernoid Sjette (Level 6) from your Deck (totaling Level 8).
Both Decatrons trigger on summon: mill Infernoid Devyaty to gain monster effect negation, and mill Infernoid Onuncu to gain Spell/Trap negation.
Decatrons and Sjette now represent 2 omni-negates and banishes from the opponent's GY on their turn.

summary.title: High-Level Bosses & Board Wipes
points: Infernoid Onuncu (Level 10) banishes 3 Infernoids to summon itself, wipes all other monsters on the field upon arrival, and tributes a monster to negate and banish a Spell/Trap Card or effect.
Infernoid Devyaty (Level 9) banishes 3 Infernoids to summon itself, destroys all other Spells and Traps on the field on summon, and tributes a monster to negate and banish a monster effect.
Every Infernoid monster can tribute 1 monster you control as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn to target and banish 1 card from their GY.

summary.title: Extra Deck Fusion & Links
points: Infernoid Evil (Level 1 Fusion) mills Infernoid monsters with different names from your Deck up to the number of materials used for its summon, and adds a Void Spell/Trap to your hand when sent to the GY.
Infernoid Flood (Link-4) negates an opponent's Special Summon and banishes that monster, and banishes a card on the field whenever a card is banished from your GY.
Infernoid Tierra dumps cards from both players' Extra Decks to the GY when summoned with 3+ materials, triggering Elder Entity N'tss to pop an opponent's card.
Gravity Controller is a Link-1 that clears your Extra Monster Zone, bypassing the Level 8 cap on field.
